title: 第十五章 隐藏的妖王血脉第十六章 晏烬和梅元知
lines: 孟川平静站在擂台上，有两名士兵将那羊妖尸体给拖了下去，也有士兵简单擦拭了下擂台。
按照斩妖盛会规矩，道院弟子只要赢了就可以继续站在擂台上和新的妖怪厮杀，只要你有足够的本事，玉阳宫就会给你安排更强的妖怪。
这时候又一辆牢车被拉上来。
孟川瞳孔一缩，那牢车内有一名很瘦很瘦的妖怪，但是那妖怪骨架很大，盘坐在牢笼内都显得身体庞大。它一双暗黄色眸子扫向外界，身上有着黑黄斑纹的干枯毛发。
“虎妖？”孟川暗惊。
“是虎妖！”
“竟是虎妖！”道院弟子们一片惊呼，妖怪当中，像猪妖、狼妖之类的数量都非常多，它们大多普普通通，偶尔也会出一些极强的妖怪。可是虎妖……数量稀少，再弱的虎妖也是大妖层次。
朝廷官员这时候也朗声笑道：“诸位，这是此次斩妖盛会第一头大妖，而且还是一头虎妖！当然他长期饥饿，身体也弱了许多，筋骨也变差。只有巅峰时三成的实力。它会是孟川的对手，也将会是脱胎境道院弟子的对手。诸位要小心了，它即便实力大减，也依旧在你们之上，务必小心。”
“哐当。”
牢笼的门被拉开，断臂男子看着虎妖，冷声道，“连胜十场，你就可以回牢房。而且还有享受一月的美食美酒。”
“十场？”
虎妖弯着身子慢悠悠从牢笼内走出来，它扫视了眼周围。
这擂台周围的观看者们，它能够在十余位身上感觉到恐怖威胁，八大道院的院长，五大家族的高手，朝廷的高手，还有玉阳宫的梅元知、断臂男子等等，加起来有十八位。即便它在巅峰时，这些恐怖的人族都是能够一个照面斩杀它的。它却不知道……整个东宁府，掌握势的强者，有超过一半今日都在场。
当然最恐怖的还是坐在主位上的那位。
玉阳宫主坐在那，在它感应中就仿佛一轮太阳！怕是稍微散发些许威力就能镇杀它。
“我的第一个对手就是这个小家伙？”虎妖看着擂台另一边的孟川，“真弱。”
“虎妖！”孟川精神提到十二分，眼中光芒内敛，杀意却越加汹涌。
可他依旧站在原地一动不动，这个位置是在擂台边缘，虎妖扑杀过来也得小心出了擂台——妖怪们一旦出了擂台，必死无疑！
先探一探虎妖的底细，再定下战斗计划。
虎妖一扑，便带着铺面而来的腥风，眨眼就到了面前。
嗖。
孟川立即一闪，暴退闪避的同时也是一刀劈出，却被那虎爪给挡住了，震得孟川落地后都连退了几步。
“我最擅长的速度，它竟然不亚于我。”孟川暗惊，“力量比我都强一倍。这是他巅峰时三成的实力？幸好，他战斗技艺虽然纯熟，却没有达到‘合一境’层次。”
“以我之长，攻敌之短。”
“我有机会杀它！”
孟川瞬间做出决断。
寻常道院弟子第一次和妖怪厮杀会紧张，平常十成实力能发挥七成就不错了。孟川不同，从小压抑在心底的火焰在遇到妖怪就爆发了，他反而更亢奋！精神更集中！身心结合更加完美，实力爆发都能更强一筹。这就是临战状态。
状态好，超水平发挥。
“竟然躲过了？有点意思。”虎妖低沉说着，再度扑杀而来。
content_en:
Meng Chuan stood calmly on the ring. Two soldiers dragged the body of the goat demon down, and some soldiers simply wiped the ring.
According to the rules of the monster-slaying event, Taoist disciples can continue to stand in the ring and fight new monsters as long as they win. As long as you have enough skills, Yuyang Palace will arrange stronger monsters for you.
At this time, another prison car was pulled up.
"Huh?"
Meng Chuan's pupils shrank. There was a very thin monster in the prison car, but the monster had a big frame and looked huge even sitting cross-legged in the cage. Its dark yellow eyes glanced at the outside world, and its body had dry hair with black and yellow markings.
"Tiger demon?" Meng Chuan was shocked.
"It's a tiger demon!"
"It's actually a tiger monster!" The Taoist disciples exclaimed. Among the monsters, there are a lot of them, such as pig monsters and wolf monsters. Most of them are ordinary, but occasionally there are some extremely powerful monsters. But tiger demons...are few in number, and even the weakest tiger demons are still at the level of great demons.
The court officials also laughed loudly at this time and said: "Everyone, this is the first big monster in this monster-slaying event, and it is also a tiger monster! Of course, he has been hungry for a long time, his body has become much weaker, and his muscles and bones have also deteriorated. He is only 30% of his peak strength. It will be Meng Chuan's opponent, and it will also be the opponent of the disciples of the Reborn Realm Taoist Academy. You should be careful, even if its strength is greatly reduced, it is still above you, so be careful."
"Clang."
The door of the cell was opened. The man with the broken arm looked at the tiger demon and said coldly, "If you win ten games in a row, you can go back to the cell. And you can enjoy a month of food and wine."
"Ten games?"
The tiger demon bent over and slowly walked out of the cage, and glanced around.
Among the spectators around the ring, it could sense a terrifying threat from more than ten of them, including the dean of the Eight Great Avenues, masters of the five major families, masters of the imperial court, Mei Yuanzhi of Yuyang Palace, the man with a broken arm, etc., totaling eighteen. Even when it was at its peak, these terrifying humans could kill it face to face. But it doesn't know... In the entire Dongning Mansion, more than half of the powerful people with power are present today.
Of course, the most terrifying thing is the one sitting in the main seat.
The Master of Yuyang Palace was sitting there, feeling like a sun in its induction! I'm afraid that if it exudes just a little bit of power, it will be able to kill it.
"My first opponent is this little guy?" The tiger demon looked at Meng Chuan on the other side of the ring, "How weak."
"Tiger demon!" Meng Chuan's spirit was at a high level, the light in his eyes was restrained, but his murderous intent became more intense.
But he still stood there motionless. This position was on the edge of the ring. Even if the tiger monster came to attack him, he had to be careful when he got out of the ring - once the monsters left the ring, they would definitely die!
First explore the details of the tiger demon, and then make a battle plan.
"Huh."
The tiger demon pounced, carrying the fishy wind coming from the shop, and was in front of him in the blink of an eye.
Whoosh.
Meng Chuan immediately dodged, and while dodging violently, he also slashed out with a knife, but was blocked by the tiger's claws, which shocked Meng Chuan even after he landed on the ground, he even took a few steps back.
"The speed I'm best at is as good as mine." Meng Chuan was shocked. "It's twice as powerful as me. Is this 30% of his peak strength? Fortunately, although his fighting skills are proficient, he has not reached the level of 'Unity Realm'."
"Use my strengths to attack the enemy's weaknesses."
"I'll kill it when I get a chance!"
Meng Chuan made an instant decision.
Normally, Taoist disciples would be nervous when fighting monsters for the first time. Normally, it would be good to be able to use 10% of their strength to achieve 70%. Meng Chuan was different. The fire that had been suppressed in his heart since childhood burst out when he encountered monsters, and he became even more excited! Be more focused! The combination of body and mind is more perfect, and the burst of strength can be stronger. This is the state of war.
In good condition and performing at a superb level.
"You actually dodged it? It's interesting." The tiger demon said in a low voice and attacked again.
